title.zh: 卷441 列傳二百二十八 潘祖荫 李文田 孙诒经 夏同善 张家骧 张英麟 张仁黼 张亨嘉
title.en: Volume 441 Biographies 228: Pan Zuyin, Li Wentian, Sun Yijing, Xia Tongshan, Zhang Jiaxiang, Zhang Yinglin, Zhang Renfu, Zhang Hengjia
title.raw: 卷441 列傳二百二十八 潘祖荫 李文田 孙诒经 夏同善 张家骧 张英麟 张仁黼 张亨嘉

sentences.zh: 列傳二百二十八

translations.literal: Biographies 228
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 228

sentences.zh: 潘祖廕李文田孫詒經夏同善張家驤

translations.literal: Pan Zuyin, Li Wentian, Sun Yijing, Xia Tongshan, and Zhang Jiaxiang
translations.idiomatic: [Biographies of] Pan Zuyin, Li Wentian, Sun Yijing, Xia Tongshan, and Zhang Jiaxiang

sentences.zh: 張英麟張仁黼張亨嘉

translations.literal: Zhang Yinglin, Zhang Renfu, and Zhang Hengjia
translations.idiomatic: [Biographies of] Zhang Yinglin, Zhang Renfu, and Zhang Hengjia

sentences.zh: 潘祖廕，字伯寅，江蘇吳縣人，大學士世恩孫。

translations.literal: Pan Zuyin, courtesy name Boyin, was a native of Wuxian in Jiangsu, and grandson of the Grand Secretary Shi'en.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Zuyin, styled Boyin, came from Wuxian in Jiangsu and was the grandson of Grand Secretary Pan Shi'en.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年一甲三名進士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng he took third place in the first class of the jinshi examination and was appointed Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In 1852 he placed third among the top three graduates of the palace examination and was appointed a compiler in the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 遷侍讀，入直南書房，充日講起居注官。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Reader, entered service in the Southern Studio, and served as Daily Lecturer and Recorder of the Emperor's Movements.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Reader, joined the Southern Studio staff, and served as Daily Lecturer and Recorder of the Emperor's Activities.

sentences.zh: 累遷侍讀學士，除大理寺少卿。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Reader of the Hanlin Academy, then appointed Vice Minister of the Court of Revision.
translations.idiomatic: Through successive promotions he became a Reader of the Hanlin Academy and was then appointed Vice Minister of the Court of Revision.

sentences.zh: 左宗棠被劾，召對簿，罪不測，祖廕上疏營救，且密薦其能，獄解，乃起獨領一軍。

translations.literal: Zuo Zongtang was impeached and summoned for interrogation; his guilt was uncertain. Zuyin submitted a memorial to rescue him and privately recommended his ability. The case was resolved, and [Zuo] was then restored to command an army alone.
translations.idiomatic: When Zuo Zongtang was impeached and summoned to answer charges with his fate uncertain, Zuyin memorialized in his defense and quietly praised his talents. After the case was closed, Zuo was restored and placed in sole command of an army.

sentences.zh: 十一年，詔求直言，祖廕念車駕還都，首斥奸佞，綱紀一新，為上勤聖學、求人才、整軍務、裕倉儲四事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year an edict sought forthright counsel. Zuyin, mindful that the imperial carriage had returned to the capital and had first expelled treacherous favorites and renewed discipline, set forth four matters for the throne: diligent pursuit of sacred learning, recruitment of talent, rectification of military affairs, and replenishment of granary stores.
translations.idiomatic: In 1861 an edict called for candid remonstrance. Noting that the court had returned to the capital and had already begun by driving out corrupt favorites and renewing discipline, Zuyin urged the emperor to pursue four priorities: devoted study, recruitment of capable men, military reform, and fuller granary reserves.

sentences.zh: 並請免賦以蘇民困，汰釐以紓民力，嚴軍律以拯民生，廣中額以收民心。

translations.literal: He also requested exemption of levies to relieve the people's distress, elimination of surtax offices to ease the people's burden, strict military discipline to rescue the people's livelihood, and expansion of provincial quotas to win the people's hearts.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked for tax relief to ease popular hardship, abolition of surtax collection to lighten burdens, stern military discipline to protect civilian life, and increased provincial examination quotas to win public trust.

sentences.zh: 纚纚數千言，稱旨。

translations.literal: In several thousand words arranged in order, [the memorial] pleased the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: His orderly memorial of several thousand words pleased the throne.

sentences.zh: 遷光祿寺卿。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 與修治平寶鑑，書成，被賞賚。

translations.literal: He participated in compiling the Precious Mirror of Governance and Peace; when the book was completed, he received rewards.
translations.idiomatic: He helped compile the Precious Mirror of Governance and Peace and was rewarded when the work was finished.

sentences.zh: 先後糾彈官吏不職狀，書凡數上，文若欽差勝保、直隸總督文煜、陝西巡撫英棨、布政使毛震壽、甘肅布政使恩麟、道員田在田諸人；

translations.literal: He successively impeached officials for malfeasance; memorials were submitted several times, [naming] among civil officials the imperial commissioner Sheng Bao, the Zhili governor-general Wen Yu, the Shaanxi governor Ying Qi, the provincial administration commissioner Mao Zhenshou, the Gansu provincial administration commissioner En Lin, the circuit intendant Tian Zaitian, and others;
translations.idiomatic: Over time he repeatedly impeached negligent officials in several memorials, naming among civil officials the imperial commissioner Sheng Bao, Zhili governor-general Wen Yu, Shaanxi governor Ying Qi, provincial administration commissioners Mao Zhenshou and En Lin of Gansu, circuit intendant Tian Zaitian, and others;

sentences.zh: 武若提督孔廣順、總兵閻丕敘、副將張維義諸人。

translations.literal: among military officials the provincial commander Kong Guangshun, the regional commander Yan Pixu, the brigade commander Zhang Weiyi, and others.
translations.idiomatic: and among military officers provincial commander Kong Guangshun, regional commander Yan Pixu, brigade commander Zhang Weiyi, and others.

sentences.zh: 繇是直聲震朝端。

translations.literal: From this his reputation for integrity resounded at court.
translations.idiomatic: From this his reputation for integrity resounded throughout the court.

sentences.zh: 同治三年，授左副都御史。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tongzhi he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In 1864 he was appointed Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 坐會議何桂清罪未列銜，絓吏議。

translations.literal: He was punished because in the council on He Guiqing's crime his name was not listed in the memorial heading, and was entangled in an official review.
translations.idiomatic: He was censured because, in the deliberation on He Guiqing's case, his name had been omitted from the memorial heading.

sentences.zh: 明年，恭親王奕訢獲譴，下群臣議。

translations.literal: The next year Prince Gong Yixin was punished, and the matter was referred to the ministers for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Prince Gong Yixin was reprimanded, and the matter was referred to the ministers for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 祖廕念重臣進退，關係安危，疏請持平用中，酌予轉圜，袪世人惑。

translations.literal: Zuyin, mindful that the advancement and withdrawal of great ministers bore on security and peril, memorialized asking that the mean be upheld and moderation used, that a measure of accommodation be granted, and that public confusion be dispelled.
translations.idiomatic: Mindful that the rise and fall of great ministers bore on the dynasty's safety, Zuyin memorialized asking that the court hold to moderation, grant a measure of accommodation, and clear away public confusion.

sentences.zh: 補工部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was appointed Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 七年，調戶部，充經筵講官。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to the Board of Revenue and appointed lecturer at the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: In 1868 he was transferred to the Board of Revenue and appointed lecturer at the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 坐失部印，褫職留任。

translations.literal: He was punished for losing the ministry seal, stripped of office but retained in post.
translations.idiomatic: He was punished for losing the ministry seal and was stripped of rank but kept in his post.

sentences.zh: 典順天鄉試，再坐中式舉人徐景春文理荒謬，鐫二級。

translations.literal: Presiding over the Shuntian provincial examination, he was again punished because the successful candidate Xu Jingchun's literary composition was absurdly poor, and was demoted two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: While presiding over the Shuntian provincial examination, he was again censured because the successful candidate Xu Jingchun's essay was absurdly poor, and was demoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 十三年，特旨賞編修，仍入直。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, by special edict he was rewarded with the post of Compiler and again entered regular palace service.
translations.idiomatic: In 1874, by special edict he was restored to the rank of compiler and again entered regular palace service.

sentences.zh: 錄輸餉功，釋處分。

translations.literal: His merit in delivering supplies was recorded, and his punishment was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: His merit in delivering supplies was recorded, and his punishment was lifted.

sentences.zh: 光緒改元，授大理寺卿，補禮部右侍郎。

translations.literal: At the change of reign to Guangxu he was appointed Minister of the Court of Revision and made up the vacancy as Right Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Guangxu reign he was appointed Minister of the Court of Revision and then Right Vice Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 數遷工部尚書，加太子少保。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Minister of Works and given the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through several posts to Minister of Works and was given the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 五年，主事吳可讀以死請為穆宗立嗣，祖廕被命集議，與徐桐等請申不建儲，彝訓疏存毓慶宮。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the department director Wu Kedu died petitioning that an heir be established for Emperor Muzong. Zuyin was ordered to assemble for deliberation; with Xu Tong and others he requested that the precedent against establishing an heir be cited, and the canonical instructions and memorials were kept in the Palace of Nurturing Joy.
translations.idiomatic: In 1879 the department director Wu Kedu died petitioning that an heir be named for the late Emperor Muzong. Zuyin was ordered to join the deliberation; with Xu Tong and others he argued that precedent against formally establishing an heir should be invoked, and the relevant canonical instructions and memorials were kept in the Palace of Nurturing Joy.

sentences.zh: 明年，偕惇親王奕脤等辦中俄交涉。

translations.literal: The next year, together with Prince Dun Yishun and others, he handled Sino-Russian negotiations.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, together with Prince Dun Yishun and others, he handled Sino-Russian negotiations.

sentences.zh: 約既成，籌善後，條列練兵、簡器、開礦、備餉四事進。

translations.literal: After the treaty was concluded, he planned for the aftermath and submitted a list of four matters: drill troops, simplify armaments, open mines, and prepare provisions.
translations.idiomatic: After the treaty was concluded, he planned for the aftermath and submitted four proposals: drill the troops, streamline armaments, open mines, and stock provisions.

sentences.zh: 命入直軍機，父憂歸。

translations.literal: He was ordered to enter regular service in the Grand Council; he returned home on his father's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered into regular service on the Grand Council, then returned home to observe mourning for his father.

sentences.zh: 服闋，起權兵部尚書，調補工部，兼管順天府尹事。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was restored to acting Minister of War, transferred to fill the post at the Board of Works, and concurrently managed the affairs of the Shuntian metropolitan magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he was restored as acting Minister of War, transferred to the Board of Works, and concurrently oversaw the Shuntian metropolitan magistrate.

sentences.zh: 大婚禮成，晉太子太保。

translations.literal: When the grand wedding ceremony was completed, he was advanced to Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: After the grand wedding ceremony was completed, he was advanced to Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十六年，卒，贈太子太傅，諡文勤。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he died; he was posthumously given the title Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent and the posthumous name Wenqin.
translations.idiomatic: In 1890 he died; he was posthumously given the title Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent and the posthumous name Wenqin.

sentences.zh: 寶坻士紳感其救災勤勞，籥建專祠，報可。

translations.literal: The gentry and scholars of Baodi, moved by his diligent labor in disaster relief, petitioned to build a special shrine; approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The gentry and scholars of Baodi, moved by his diligent work in disaster relief, petitioned to build a shrine in his honor, and the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 祖廕嗜學，通經史，好收藏，儲金石甚富。

translations.literal: Zuyin loved learning, was versed in the classics and histories, delighted in collecting, and stored a very rich collection of bronzes and stone inscriptions.
translations.idiomatic: Zuyin was devoted to learning, well versed in the classics and histories, an avid collector, and possessed a very rich store of bronzes and stone inscriptions.

sentences.zh: 先後數掌文衡，典會試二、鄉試三，所得多真士。

translations.literal: He several times presided over literary examinations, conducted two metropolitan examinations and three provincial examinations, and obtained many genuine scholars.
translations.idiomatic: He presided over literary examinations several times, conducting two metropolitan and three provincial examinations, and selected many genuinely capable scholars.

sentences.zh: 時與翁同龢並稱翁潘雲。

translations.literal: At the time he and Weng Tonghe were together called the clouds of Weng and Pan.
translations.idiomatic: At the time he and Weng Tonghe were together spoken of as the twin luminaries of Weng and Pan.

sentences.zh: 李文田，字芍農，廣東順德人。

translations.literal: Li Wentian, courtesy name Shaonong, was a native of Shunde in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Li Wentian, styled Shaonong, came from Shunde in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 咸豐九年一甲三名進士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Xianfeng he took third place in the first class of the jinshi examination and was appointed Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In 1859 he placed third among the top three graduates of the palace examination and was appointed a compiler in the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 入直南書房，充日講起居注官。

translations.literal: He entered service in the Southern Studio and served as Daily Lecturer and Recorder of the Emperor's Movements.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the Southern Studio staff and served as Daily Lecturer and Recorder of the Emperor's Activities.

sentences.zh: 同治五年，大考，晉中允。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tongzhi, in the great examination, he was promoted to Middle Sublector.
translations.idiomatic: In 1866, in the triennial examination of Hanlin academicians, he was promoted to Middle Sublector.

sentences.zh: 九年，督江西學政。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he supervised education in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In 1870 he was appointed educational commissioner of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 累遷侍讀學士。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Reader of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive promotions to Reader of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 秩滿，其母年已七十有七矣，將乞終養，會聞朝廷議修園籞，遂入都覆命。

translations.literal: When his term ended, his mother was already seventy-seven years old; he was about to request permanent care for her in retirement, but upon hearing that the court was deliberating repair of the imperial gardens, he entered the capital to report on his duties.
translations.idiomatic: When his term ended, his mother was already seventy-seven; he was about to request leave to care for her in retirement, but upon hearing that the court was deliberating repairs to the imperial gardens, he went to the capital to report on his duties.

sentences.zh: 既至，謁軍機大臣寶鋆，告以東南事可危，李光昭姦猥無行，責其不能匡救。

translations.literal: Once arrived, he called on the Grand Councilor Bao Kun and told him that affairs in the southeast were perilous, that Li Guangzhao was licentious and base in conduct, and reproached him for failing to correct and save [the situation].
translations.idiomatic: On arrival he called on Grand Councilor Bao Kun, warned him that affairs in the southeast were perilous, denounced Li Guangzhao as corrupt and depraved, and reproached him for failing to set matters right.

sentences.zh: 寶鋆曰：「居南齋亦可言，奚必責樞府？

translations.literal: Bao Kun said: "Serving in the Southern Studio one may also speak; why must you blame the Grand Council?"
translations.idiomatic: Bao Kun said, "Serving in the Southern Studio you may speak up as well; why must you blame the Grand Council?"

sentences.zh: 」文田日：「正為是來耳！

translations.literal: Wentian said: "It is precisely for that that I have come!"
translations.idiomatic: Wentian said, "That is precisely why I have come!"

sentences.zh: 」疏上，不報。

translations.literal: His memorial was submitted but received no response.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted his memorial, but received no response.

sentences.zh: 逾歲，上停止園工封事，略言：「巴夏禮等焚毀圓明園，其人尚存。

translations.literal: After more than a year he submitted a memorial to halt garden works, stating in brief: "Parkes and others burned the Old Summer Palace, and those men still live.
translations.idiomatic: More than a year later he submitted a memorial to halt work on the gardens, stating in brief: "Parkes and others burned the Old Summer Palace, and those men are still alive.

sentences.zh: 昔既焚之而不懼，安能禁其後之不復為？

translations.literal: If in the past they burned it without fear, how can one forbid them from doing it again afterward?"
translations.idiomatic: If they burned it once without fear, how can we be sure they will not do it again?"

sentences.zh: 常人之家偶被盜劫，猶必固其門牆，慎其管鑰，未聞有揮金誇富於盜前者。

translations.literal: When an ordinary household is occasionally robbed, it still must strengthen its gates and walls and be careful with keys; one has never heard of flinging gold to display wealth before the robber.
translations.idiomatic: When an ordinary household is robbed, it still strengthens its gates and guards its keys; one never hears of flaunting wealth before the thief.

sentences.zh: 今彗星見，天象譴告，而猶忍而出此，此必內府諸臣及左右憸人導皇上以朘削窮民之舉。

translations.literal: Now a comet has appeared, a heavenly sign of reproof, yet [the court] still bears to put this forth — this must be the inner palace officials and fawning men at the emperor's side leading His Majesty into measures that drain and impoverish the people.
translations.idiomatic: Now a comet has appeared as a heavenly warning, yet the court still bears to proceed — this must be inner-palace officials and sycophants at the emperor's side leading him into measures that drain and impoverish the people.

sentences.zh: 使朘削而果無他患，則唐至元、明將至今存，大清何以有天下乎？

translations.literal: If draining the people truly brought no other calamity, then from Tang through Yuan and Ming they would still exist today — how did the Great Qing come to possess the realm?
translations.idiomatic: If draining the people truly brought no other calamity, dynasties from Tang through Yuan and Ming would still rule today — how then did the Great Qing come to possess the realm?

sentences.zh: 皇上亦思圓明園之所以興乎？

translations.literal: Does Your Majesty also reflect on why the Old Summer Palace arose in the first place?
translations.idiomatic: Does Your Majesty also reflect on why the Old Summer Palace was built in the first place?

sentences.zh: 其時高宗西北拓地數千里，東西諸國讋憚天威，府庫充盈，物力豐盛，園工取之內帑而民不知，故皆樂園之成。

translations.literal: At that time the Gaozong Emperor extended territory in the northwest by several thousand li; the states east and west were awed by heavenly might; the treasuries were full and material resources abundant; garden works were taken from the inner treasury without the people knowing, and therefore all rejoiced in the gardens' completion.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Qianlong Emperor had extended the northwest frontier by thousands of li; states east and west were awed by imperial might; the treasuries were full and resources abundant; garden works were paid from the inner treasury without the people knowing, and all rejoiced in their completion.

sentences.zh: 今皆反是，聖明在上，此不待思而決者矣。

translations.literal: Now all is the reverse; with sagely clarity above, this needs no deliberation to decide.
translations.idiomatic: Now all is the reverse; with a sagely ruler above, the decision needs no deliberation.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，上為動容。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, the emperor was moved.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was received, the emperor was visibly moved.

sentences.zh: 俄乞假歸。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he requested leave to return home.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he requested leave to return home.

sentences.zh: 光緒八年，遭母憂。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Guangxu he suffered his mother's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In 1882 he entered mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 服竟，起故官，入直如故。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he was restored to his former office and entered regular service as before.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he was restored to his former office and resumed regular palace service as before.

sentences.zh: 數遷至禮部侍郎，充經筵講官，領閣事。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Vice Minister of Rites, served as lecturer at the Classics Colloquium, and headed secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through several posts to Vice Minister of Rites, served as lecturer at the Classics Colloquium, and headed secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 二十年，疏請起用恭親王奕訢及前布政使遊智開，依行。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he memorialized requesting the restoration of Prince Gong Yixin and the former provincial administration commissioner You Zhikai; [the requests] were carried out as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: In 1894 he memorialized requesting the restoration of Prince Gong Yixin and the former provincial administration commissioner You Zhikai; both requests were approved.

sentences.zh: 明年，卒，卹如製，諡文誠。

translations.literal: The next year he died; condolence followed the regulations, and he was given the posthumous name Wencheng.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he died; condolence followed the regulations, and he was given the posthumous name Wencheng.

sentences.zh: 文田學識淹通，述作有體，尤諳究西北輿地。

translations.literal: Wentian's learning was broad and penetrating, his writings had proper form, and he was especially well versed in the geography of the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Wentian's learning was broad and penetrating, his writings were well formed, and he was especially expert in the geography of the northwest.

sentences.zh: 屢典試事，類能識拔績學，士皆稱之。

translations.literal: He repeatedly presided over examinations and generally could recognize and elevate solid scholars; the literati all praised him.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly presided over examinations and generally recognized and elevated solid scholars; the literati all praised him.

sentences.zh: 孫詒經，字子授，浙江錢塘人。

translations.literal: Sun Yijing, courtesy name Zishou, was a native of Qiantang in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Yijing, styled Zishou, came from Qiantang in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 咸豐十年進士，選庶吉士。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Xianfeng he passed the jinshi examination and was selected as a Hanlin bachelor.
translations.idiomatic: In 1860 he passed the palace examination and was selected as a Hanlin bachelor.

sentences.zh: 聞杭州城陷，乞假歸，奉親闢居定海。

translations.literal: Upon hearing that Hangzhou had fallen, he requested leave to return home, attended his parents, and took refuge at Dinghai.
translations.idiomatic: When he heard that Hangzhou had fallen, he requested leave to return home, cared for his parents, and took refuge at Dinghai.

sentences.zh: 參寧紹台道張景渠軍，平浙東有功，還授檢討。

translations.literal: He joined the army of Zhang Jingqu, intendant of the Ning-Shao-Tai Circuit, and had merit in pacifying eastern Zhejiang; he returned and was appointed Reviser.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the forces of Zhang Jingqu, intendant of the Ning-Shao-Tai Circuit, and helped pacify eastern Zhejiang; afterward he was appointed Reviser.

sentences.zh: 以倭仁薦，入直南書房。

translations.literal: On Woren's recommendation he entered regular service in the Southern Studio.
translations.idiomatic: On Woren's recommendation he joined the Southern Studio staff.

sentences.zh: 同治四年，擢司業。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tongzhi he was promoted to Vice Director of Studies.
translations.idiomatic: In 1865 he was promoted to Vice Director of Studies.

sentences.zh: 上言：「弭災在卹刑，治獄先平法。

translations.literal: He addressed the throne: "Quelling calamity lies in compassionate punishment; governing prisons must first even out the law.
translations.idiomatic: He addressed the throne: "Quelling calamity lies in compassionate punishment; governing prisons must first even out the law.

sentences.zh: 本律盜案不分首從，聖祖、世宗加以區別。

translations.literal: The original code for robbery cases did not distinguish principal and accomplice; the Sacred Ancestor and Shizong added distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: The original code for robbery cases did not distinguish principals from accomplices; the Kangxi and Yongzheng emperors added such distinctions.

sentences.zh: 自頃盜風充斥，概用重典，行十餘年，案不減少。

translations.literal: Recently robbery has been widespread and heavy penalties have been applied uniformly; this has been practiced for more than ten years, yet cases have not diminished.
translations.idiomatic: Recently robbery has been widespread and heavy penalties have been applied uniformly; this policy has been in force for more than ten years, yet cases have not diminished.

sentences.zh: 則知弭盜之術，不在用法之嚴。

translations.literal: From this one knows that the art of quelling robbery does not lie in severity of application of the law.
translations.idiomatic: This shows that the art of quelling robbery does not lie in severity of punishment.

sentences.zh: 請敕刑部改成例，复祖制。

translations.literal: I request that the Ministry of Justice be ordered to revise the regulations into precedent and restore the ancestral system."
translations.idiomatic: I request that the Ministry of Justice be ordered to revise the regulations into precedent and restore the ancestral system."

sentences.zh: 」議行。

translations.literal: The proposal was deliberated and carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved and carried out.

sentences.zh: 會上將侍太后幸惇親王府，既，與夏同善諫罷。

translations.literal: It happened that the emperor was about to attend the Empress Dowager on a visit to Prince Dun's residence; afterward, together with Xia Tongshan, he remonstrated and [the visit] was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor was about to accompany the Empress Dowager on a visit to Prince Dun's residence, he and Xia Tongshan remonstrated and the visit was canceled.

sentences.zh: 未幾，復將詣恭親王府祀神，詒經再上疏，言：「聖學方新，宸修宜懋。

translations.literal: Before long [the emperor] was again about to go to Prince Gong's residence to sacrifice to the gods; Yijing again submitted a memorial, stating: "Sacred learning has just been renewed; the emperor's cultivation should be vigorous.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the emperor was again about to go to Prince Gong's residence to sacrifice to the gods; Yijing submitted another memorial, stating: "Sacred learning has just been renewed; the emperor's cultivation should be vigorous.

sentences.zh: 經帷屢曠，則神誌難專；

translations.literal: If the Classics Colloquium is repeatedly left vacant, then the spirit and will are hard to concentrate;
translations.idiomatic: If the Classics Colloquium is repeatedly neglected, the mind cannot remain focused;

sentences.zh: 法駕時勤，則見聞易惑。

translations.literal: if the imperial carriage is frequently active, then what is seen and heard is easily confused.
translations.idiomatic: if the imperial carriage is frequently abroad, what the emperor sees and hears is easily confused.

sentences.zh: 一日行幸，一日已荒念典之功；

translations.literal: One day of imperial progress, and one day's work of recalling the canon is wasted;
translations.idiomatic: One day spent on an outing wastes a day's work of recalling the canon;

sentences.zh: 今日行禮，異日或啟遊觀之漸。

translations.literal: today performing rites, on another day perhaps opening the gradual slide into sightseeing.
translations.idiomatic: today performing rites, tomorrow perhaps opening the way to sightseeing excursions.

sentences.zh: 」士論歸之。

translations.literal: Scholarly opinion rallied to him.
translations.idiomatic: Scholarly opinion rallied to him.

sentences.zh: 遭父憂去，服除，仍原官，入直如故。

translations.literal: He left office on his father's mourning; when mourning ended he retained his former office and entered regular service as before.
translations.idiomatic: He left office to observe mourning for his father; when mourning ended he retained his former office and resumed regular palace service as before.

sentences.zh: 十年，遷侍講。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was promoted to Lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: In 1871 he was promoted to Lecturer.

sentences.zh: 五月朔，日食。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fifth month there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 詒經以天道感應，本諸人事，於是有遇災修省之請。

translations.literal: Yijing held that heavenly responses correspond to human affairs at root, and on this basis submitted a request to meet calamity with self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: Yijing held that heavenly signs respond to human affairs, and on this basis submitted a request to meet calamity with self-examination and reform.

sentences.zh: 十三年夏，彗星見，越數日，太白經天，人心惶駭。

translations.literal: In the summer of the thirteenth year a comet appeared; after several days Venus crossed the heavens, and people's hearts were alarmed and terrified.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of 1874 a comet appeared; several days later Venus crossed the heavens, and public alarm spread.

sentences.zh: 詒經復有廣開言路及罷圓明園工程之請。

translations.literal: Yijing again made requests to broaden the avenue of remonstrance and to halt work on the Old Summer Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Yijing again requested broader avenues of remonstrance and an end to work on the Old Summer Palace.

sentences.zh: 遷侍讀學士。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Reader of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Reader of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 德宗纘業，大考一等，擢詹事。

translations.literal: When Emperor Dezong succeeded to the enterprise, in the great examination he took first rank and was promoted to Junior Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Guangxu succeeded to the throne, he took first rank in the triennial examination and was promoted to Junior Mentor.

sentences.zh: 召對，命直抒所見，連上澄吏治、慎海防機宜甚悉。

translations.literal: Summoned for audience, he was ordered to speak his views directly; he submitted in succession very detailed memorials on clarifying official governance and prudent coastal defense measures.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned for audience, he was told to speak frankly; he submitted in succession detailed memorials on clarifying official governance and prudent coastal defense.

sentences.zh: 光緒六年，俄釁啟，東西海陸邊防亟。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Guangxu the Russian quarrel opened; eastern and western sea and land border defenses were urgent.
translations.idiomatic: In 1880 the Russian crisis erupted, and coastal and land border defenses east and west grew urgent.

sentences.zh: 詒經言：「能戰然後能和，兵力專顧海口，北塘覆轍可鑑。

translations.literal: Yijing stated: "Only after one can fight can one then make peace; military strength should focus on guarding the estuary — the repeated disaster at Beitang can serve as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: Yijing stated: "Only after one can fight can one make peace; military strength should focus on guarding the estuary — the repeated disaster at Beitang stands as a warning.

sentences.zh: 」請調勁旅守東路，並津、永舉辦民團。

translations.literal: He requested that strong troops be transferred to guard the eastern route, and that militia be organized in Tianjin and Yongping as well.
translations.idiomatic: He requested that strong troops be transferred to guard the eastern route, and that militia be organized in Tianjin and Yongping as well.

sentences.zh: 再遷刑部侍郎，明年，調戶部。

translations.literal: He was again promoted to Vice Minister of Justice; the next year he was transferred to the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was again promoted to Vice Minister of Justice; the following year he was transferred to the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 會左宗棠請修畿輔水利，乃疏薦張之洞、張佩綸資治理，並以山東河患，河員專治河堤，不講修導，建議購泰西機船及時修濬。

translations.literal: It happened that Zuo Zongtang requested repair of waterworks in the metropolitan region; he then memorialized recommending Zhang Zhidong and Zhang Peilun as qualified for governance, and citing the river calamity in Shandong — river officials devoted themselves only to river dikes and did not attend to dredging and diversion — proposed purchasing Western steam vessels and timely dredging.
translations.idiomatic: When Zuo Zongtang requested repair of waterworks in the metropolitan region, he memorialized recommending Zhang Zhidong and Zhang Peilun as qualified administrators, and citing the river calamity in Shandong — where river officials devoted themselves only to dikes and neglected dredging and diversion — proposed purchasing Western steam vessels for timely dredging.

sentences.zh: 十一年，入直毓慶宮。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he entered regular service in the Palace of Nurturing Joy.
translations.idiomatic: In 1885 he entered regular service in the Palace of Nurturing Joy.

sentences.zh: 山東河工領部銀百萬，詒經廉得書吏史恩濤苛索狀，嚴責繳還，將懲治，章未上，而御史王賡榮等輒劾以輕縱。

translations.literal: For Shandong river works he received a million taels of ministry silver; Yijing with integrity obtained evidence of the clerk Shi Entao's extortionate demands, severely reproved him and ordered repayment, and was about to punish him — the memorial had not yet been submitted when the censor Wang Gengrong and others promptly impeached [Yijing] for undue leniency.
translations.idiomatic: For Shandong river works he received a million taels of ministry silver; Yijing uncovered evidence that the clerk Shi Entao had been extorting funds, severely reproved him and ordered repayment, and was about to punish him — but before his memorial was submitted, Censor Wang Gengrong and others impeached him for undue leniency.

sentences.zh: 上令明白回奏，覆奏入，卒陷吏議，並罷直。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered a clear reply memorial; when the reply memorial entered, he was ultimately entangled in official review and also dismissed from regular service.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered a clear reply; when his reply was received, he was ultimately censured and dismissed from regular palace service.

sentences.zh: 有勸引退者，詒經曰：「吾被恩遇久，遑敢佚吾身邪？

translations.literal: When some urged him to withdraw, Yijing said: "I have long received imperial favor — how dare I indulge my person?"
translations.idiomatic: When some urged him to withdraw, Yijing said, "I have long received imperial favor — how dare I indulge myself?"

sentences.zh: 」於是專治部事，佐度支凡十年。

translations.literal: Thereupon he devoted himself solely to ministry affairs and assisted in revenue matters for ten years in all.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he devoted himself solely to ministry affairs and assisted in revenue matters for ten years.

sentences.zh: 時議設銀行，造鐵路，慮利權外溢，龂龂持異議。

translations.literal: At the time there was discussion of establishing banks and building railways; fearing that economic advantage would flow abroad, he stubbornly held dissenting views.
translations.idiomatic: When banks and railways were under discussion, fearing that economic advantage would flow abroad, he stubbornly opposed both.

sentences.zh: 詒經持躬清正，思以儒術救時敝。

translations.literal: Yijing maintained himself in integrity and purity, and sought to rescue the age's ills through Confucian learning.
translations.idiomatic: Yijing conducted himself with integrity and sought to remedy the age's ills through Confucian learning.

sentences.zh: 不阿權要，為同列所忌，卒不得行其志。

translations.literal: He did not curry favor with powerful figures, was resented by his colleagues, and ultimately could not carry out his aims.
translations.idiomatic: He would not curry favor with the powerful, was resented by his colleagues, and ultimately could not carry out his aims.

sentences.zh: 先後數司文柄，深惡末學骫骳積習，擯之惟恐不遑，所得多知名士。

translations.literal: He several times presided over literary authority, deeply detested the accumulated habits of late-learning obsequiousness, and excluded such candidates as fast as he could; those he obtained were mostly renowned scholars.
translations.idiomatic: He presided over literary examinations several times, deeply detested the obsequious habits of shallow scholarship, and excluded such candidates as fast as he could; those he selected were mostly renowned scholars.

sentences.zh: 生平論學不分漢、宋，謂經學即理學。

translations.literal: Throughout his life in discussing learning he did not distinguish Han and Song, holding that classical learning is Neo-Confucian learning.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout his life he did not distinguish Han and Song learning in his scholarship, holding that classical learning and Neo-Confucian learning were one.

sentences.zh: 又曰：「學所以厲行也，博學而薄行，學奚足尚？

translations.literal: He also said: "Learning exists to strengthen conduct; broad learning with thin conduct — what is learning worth honoring?"
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "Learning exists to strengthen conduct; broad learning with thin conduct — what is learning worth?"

sentences.zh: 」一時為學者所宗。

translations.literal: For a time he was revered by scholars.
translations.idiomatic: For a time he was revered by scholars.

sentences.zh: 十六年，卒，優詔賜卹，諡文愨。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he died; an exceptional edict granted condolence, and he was given the posthumous name Wenque.
translations.idiomatic: In 1890 he died; an exceptional edict granted condolence, and he was given the posthumous name Wenque.

sentences.zh: 夏同善，字子鬆，浙江仁和人。

translations.literal: Xia Tongshan, courtesy name Zisong, was a native of Renhe in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Tongshan, styled Zisong, came from Renhe in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 咸豐六年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Xianfeng he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and was appointed Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In 1856 he passed the palace examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and was appointed a compiler in the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 累遷右庶子，充日講起居注官。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Right Sublector, and served as Daily Lecturer and Recorder of the Emperor's Movements.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Right Sublector and served as Daily Lecturer and Recorder of the Emperor's Activities.

sentences.zh: 十年，粵寇陷江南，諸軍無所統，請屬之曾國籓；

translations.literal: In the tenth year the Cantonese rebels seized Jiangnan; the various armies had no unified command — he requested that they be placed under Zeng Guofan;
translations.idiomatic: In 1860 the Taiping rebels seized Jiangnan; the various armies had no unified command — he requested that they be placed under Zeng Guofan;

sentences.zh: 又以北塘之役，僧格林沁軍退頓通州，桂良再就議款，同善建言敵情叵測，宜專任僧格林沁備戰守：敕並依行。

translations.literal: Also, because of the Beitang campaign, Sengge Rinchen's army withdrew and encamped at Tongzhou, and Gui Liang again went to negotiate terms; Tongshan advised that the enemy's intentions were unpredictable and that Sengge Rinchen alone should be entrusted with war preparations and defense — the edict ordered both carried out as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: After the Beitang campaign, when Sengge Rinchen's army withdrew to Tongzhou and Gui Liang again went to negotiate, Tongshan advised that the enemy's intentions were unpredictable and that Sengge Rinchen alone should be entrusted with war preparations and defense — both recommendations were approved.

sentences.zh: 父憂歸，服闋，起故官。

translations.literal: He returned home on his father's mourning; when mourning ended he was restored to his former office.
translations.idiomatic: He returned home to observe mourning for his father; when mourning ended he was restored to his former office.

sentences.zh: 同治六年，遷少詹事。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tongzhi he was promoted to Junior Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: In 1867 he was promoted to Junior Mentor.

sentences.zh: 其時傳言車駕將幸惇親王府，召集梨園，同善聞之，與孫詒經合疏諫止。

translations.literal: At that time rumor spread that the imperial carriage would visit Prince Dun's residence and summon the opera troupes; on hearing this, Tongshan joined Sun Yijing in a joint memorial to remonstrate and stop it.
translations.idiomatic: At that time rumor spread that the emperor would visit Prince Dun's residence and summon opera troupes; on hearing this, Tongshan joined Sun Yijing in a joint memorial to stop the visit.

sentences.zh: 略言：「皇上沖齡，敬天未至南郊，遊幸先臨府第，未安者一。

translations.literal: They stated in brief: "Your Majesty is of tender years; in revering Heaven you have not yet reached the Southern Suburb, yet an excursion first visits a princely residence — this is the first cause for unease.
translations.idiomatic: They stated in brief: "Your Majesty is still young; you have not yet performed the suburban sacrifice to Heaven, yet an excursion would first visit a princely residence — this is the first cause for unease.

sentences.zh: 聖學端資養正，耳目玩好偶有所娛，恐疏而不密，未安者二。

translations.literal: Sacred learning properly relies on nurturing rectitude; if the ears and eyes find occasional diversions in playthings, one fears they will grow lax and not concentrated — this is the second cause for unease.
translations.idiomatic: Sacred learning properly relies on nurturing rectitude; if the ears and eyes find occasional diversions, one fears they will grow lax and unfocused — this is the second cause for unease.

sentences.zh: 近頃軍事未寧，遊觀之事傳播四方，曷以慰臣民望？

translations.literal: Recently military affairs are not settled; if sightseeing spreads in all directions, how can the hopes of officials and people be comforted?
translations.idiomatic: Recently military affairs are unsettled; if sightseeing spreads in all directions, how can the hopes of officials and people be comforted?

sentences.zh: 未安者三。

translations.literal: This is the third cause for unease.
translations.idiomatic: This is the third cause for unease.

sentences.zh: 英、俄人士雜處京畿，稍示以懈，何能帖伏？

translations.literal: British and Russian people are mixed in the capital region; if we show the slightest slackness, how can they be made submissive?
translations.idiomatic: British and Russian nationals are present throughout the capital region; if we show the slightest slackness, how can they be kept in check?

sentences.zh: 未安者四。

translations.literal: This is the fourth cause for unease.
translations.idiomatic: This is the fourth cause for unease.

sentences.zh: 夫孝以禮為歸，禮以時為大，非時不舉，古有明箴。

translations.literal: Filial piety takes ritual as its fulfillment, and ritual takes timeliness as paramount; what is not timely is not performed — antiquity has clear admonitions on this.
translations.idiomatic: Filial piety takes ritual as its fulfillment, and ritual takes timeliness as paramount; what is not timely is not performed — antiquity has clear admonitions on this.

sentences.zh: 乞罷止以彰聖德。

translations.literal: We beg that [the visit] be stopped to display sagely virtue.
translations.idiomatic: We beg that the visit be canceled to display sagely virtue.

sentences.zh: 」出督江蘇學政，遭繼母喪去職。

translations.literal: He went out to supervise education in Jiangsu, and left office on his stepmother's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as educational commissioner of Jiangsu and left office on his stepmother's mourning.

sentences.zh: 起詹事。

translations.literal: He was restored as Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: He was restored as Mentor.

sentences.zh: 十年，遷兵部右侍郎。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was promoted to Right Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: In 1871 he was promoted to Right Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 秋，患霪雨，奉其狀以上，乞申虔禱，實行敦節儉、廣賑濟、開言路、清庶獄諸政，語至剴切。

translations.literal: In autumn, afflicted by prolonged rain, he presented the situation to the throne, begging for earnest prayer, and earnestly implementing policies of thrift, broad relief, opening the avenue of remonstrance, and clearing common prisons — his words were most cutting and earnest.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, amid prolonged rains, he presented the situation to the throne, begging for earnest prayer and urging policies of thrift, broad relief, open remonstrance, and clearing of common prisons — his words were most earnest.

sentences.zh: 十三年，偕尚書廣壽詣四川按事，奏請撤永川等兵差局、綿竹等伕馬局。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, together with Minister Guangshou, he went to Sichuan to investigate affairs and memorialized requesting the abolition of the Yongchuan and other military courier bureaus and the Mianzhu and other transport-horse bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: In 1874, together with Minister Guangshou, he went to Sichuan to investigate affairs and memorialized to abolish the Yongchuan and other military courier bureaus and the Mianzhu and other transport-horse bureaus.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，命直毓慶宮授讀，固辭不獲，益屏家事勿問，退唯默坐觀書，思所以為獻納地。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he was ordered to enter regular service in the Palace of Nurturing Joy to instruct in reading; he firmly declined but could not refuse, and further screened off household affairs without inquiry; in retirement he only sat silently reading books, thinking how he might find a place to offer remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: In 1875 he was ordered into regular service in the Palace of Nurturing Joy as tutor to the heir apparent; he firmly declined but could not refuse, set household affairs aside entirely, and in private hours sat silently reading, thinking how he might find occasion to remonstrate.

sentences.zh: 先後累言盜案刑例宜復舊制，分首從；

translations.literal: He repeatedly stated that the criminal regulations for robbery cases should restore the old system and distinguish principal from accomplice;
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly urged that robbery cases should restore the old regulations distinguishing principals from accomplices;

sentences.zh: 畿輔旱，請鑿井灌田甦之；

translations.literal: when the metropolitan region suffered drought, he requested digging wells to irrigate fields and revive them;
translations.idiomatic: when the metropolitan region suffered drought, he requested digging wells to irrigate fields and revive agriculture;

sentences.zh: 晉、豫飢，請移海防關稅經費卹之。

translations.literal: when Shanxi and Henan suffered famine, he requested shifting coastal defense customs funds to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: when Shanxi and Henan suffered famine, he requested shifting coastal defense customs funds for relief.

sentences.zh: 四年，復命視學江蘇，陛辭日，力陳捐納有礙民生，無裨國用，稱旨。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was again ordered to inspect education in Jiangsu; on the day of his audience at departure he forcefully stated that purchase of office harmed the people's livelihood and did not benefit state revenue — this pleased the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In 1878 he was again ordered to inspect education in Jiangsu; at his farewell audience he forcefully argued that the sale of offices harmed the people's livelihood and did not benefit state revenue — this pleased the emperor.

sentences.zh: 明年，被命巡視山東黃河，條上治下游三事：曰濬海口，曰直河灣，曰通支河，請移機器局經費治之。

translations.literal: The next year he was ordered to inspect the Yellow River in Shandong and submitted a list of three matters for governing the lower reaches: dredge the sea mouth, straighten river bends, and open branch channels — requesting that Arsenal Bureau funds be shifted to carry this out.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was ordered to inspect the Yellow River in Shandong and submitted three proposals for the lower reaches: dredge the sea mouth, straighten river bends, and open branch channels — requesting that Arsenal Bureau funds be used for the work.

sentences.zh: 其秋，閱緣江砲台，又歷陳三不可恃，請合數省力助守江口，已築者毋廢，未築者毋增，上然其言。

translations.literal: That autumn, inspecting the coastal batteries along the river, he again set forth in detail three things that could not be relied upon, and requested that several provinces combine strength to help guard the river mouth — what was already built should not be abandoned, what was not yet built should not be added — the emperor approved his words.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, inspecting coastal batteries along the Yangtze, he again argued that three defenses were unreliable and requested that several provinces combine forces to guard the river mouth — existing batteries should not be abandoned, but new ones should not be added — the emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 嘗割俸濬江陰城河，植松五萬餘於君山，民德之。

translations.literal: He once cut his salary to dredge the Jiangyin city moat and planted more than fifty thousand pines on Jun Hill; the people were grateful to him.
translations.idiomatic: He once donated his salary to dredge the Jiangyin city moat and planted more than fifty thousand pines on Jun Hill; the people were grateful.

sentences.zh: 六年，卒，德宗聞之遽泣，其忠誠荷主知如此。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he died; when Emperor Dezong heard of it he suddenly wept — such was his loyalty in winning his lord's understanding.
translations.idiomatic: In 1880 he died; when Emperor Guangxu heard of it he wept — such was the loyalty that had won his sovereign's trust.

sentences.zh: 遺疏入，賜卹如例，諡文敬。

translations.literal: His final memorial entered; condolence was granted according to precedent, and he was given the posthumous name Wenjing.
translations.idiomatic: His final memorial was received; condolence was granted according to precedent, and he was given the posthumous name Wenjing.

sentences.zh: 子庚复，主事；

translations.literal: His son Gengfu was a department director;
translations.idiomatic: His son Gengfu was a department director;

sentences.zh: 敦复，御史。

translations.literal: Dunfu was a censor.
translations.idiomatic: Dunfu was a censor.

sentences.zh: 張家驤，字子騰，浙江鄞縣人。

translations.literal: Zhang Jiaxiang, courtesy name Ziteng, was a native of Yin County in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jiaxiang, styled Ziteng, came from Yin County in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 同治元年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and was appointed Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In 1862 he passed the palace examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and was appointed a compiler in the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 督山東學政，調山西。

translations.literal: He supervised education in Shandong, then was transferred to Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He served as educational commissioner of Shandong, then was transferred to Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 遭父憂解職，服除，起故官。

translations.literal: He left office on his father's mourning; when mourning ended he was restored to his former office.
translations.idiomatic: He left office to observe mourning for his father; when mourning ended he was restored to his former office.

sentences.zh: 遷侍講，入直南書房。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Lecturer and entered regular service in the Southern Studio.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Lecturer and joined the Southern Studio staff.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，轉侍讀，充日講起居注官。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he was transferred to Reader and served as Daily Lecturer and Recorder of the Emperor's Movements.
translations.idiomatic: In 1875 he was transferred to Reader and served as Daily Lecturer and Recorder of the Emperor's Activities.

sentences.zh: 五年，命直毓慶宮，遷侍講學士。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was ordered to enter regular service in the Palace of Nurturing Joy and was promoted to Lecturer of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In 1879 he was ordered into regular service in the Palace of Nurturing Joy and was promoted to Lecturer of the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 明年，劉銘傳奉召入都，疏請籌造清江浦鐵路，下李鴻章等議。

translations.literal: The next year Liu Mingchuan was summoned to the capital and memorialized requesting planning and construction of the Qingjiangpu railway; the matter was referred to Li Hongzhang and others for deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Liu Mingchuan was summoned to the capital and memorialized to build the Qingjiangpu railway; the matter was referred to Li Hongzhang and others for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 家驤念典學方新，講求上理，萬一言利之臣隨聲附和，一言僨事，關係匪輕，乃力陳三弊阻止之。

translations.literal: Jiaxiang, mindful that canonical learning had just been renewed and that the pursuit of higher principle was sought, feared that if profit-seeking ministers echoed in agreement, one word could ruin the affair — the relation was not light — and therefore forcefully set forth three harms to stop it.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaxiang, mindful that the emperor's classical education had just begun and that higher principles were being sought, feared that if profit-seeking ministers echoed in agreement, a single misstep could have grave consequences, and forcefully set forth three harms to stop the project.

sentences.zh: 疏入，仍令鴻章覈覆，鴻章力主銘傳策。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, [the court] still ordered Hongzhang to verify and reply; Hongzhang strongly upheld Mingchuan's plan.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was received, the court still ordered Hongzhang to verify and reply; Hongzhang strongly upheld Mingchuan's plan.

sentences.zh: 然自是御史洪良品陳五害，侍講張楷陳九不利，並隨家驤而上諫書矣，事竟寢。

translations.literal: Yet from this time the censor Hong Liangpin set forth five harms, the lecturer Zhang Kai set forth nine disadvantages, and all followed Jiaxiang in submitting remonstrance memorials — the affair was ultimately shelved.
translations.idiomatic: Yet thereafter Censor Hong Liangpin set forth five harms, Lecturer Zhang Kai set forth nine disadvantages, and all followed Jiaxiang in submitting remonstrance memorials — the project was ultimately shelved.

sentences.zh: 數遷內閣學士，充經筵講官。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Grand Secretariat Academician and served as lecturer at the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Grand Secretariat Academician and served as lecturer at the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 九年，授工部右侍郎，調吏部。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was appointed Right Vice Minister of Works and transferred to the Board of Civil Office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1883 he was appointed Right Vice Minister of Works and transferred to the Board of Civil Office.

sentences.zh: 家驤純謹好學，一謝時趨。

translations.literal: Jiaxiang was pure, cautious, and fond of learning, and wholly rejected contemporary fashions.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaxiang was pure, cautious, and devoted to learning, and wholly rejected contemporary fashions.

sentences.zh: 蒞官端慎。

translations.literal: In assuming office he was upright and cautious.
translations.idiomatic: In office he was upright and cautious.

sentences.zh: 授帝讀，朝夕納誨，頗能盡心所職。

translations.literal: Instructing the emperor in reading, morning and evening offering admonition, he was quite able to devote himself fully to his duties.
translations.idiomatic: As tutor to the emperor, offering admonition morning and evening, he devoted himself fully to his duties.

sentences.zh: 十年，卒，上悼惜，賜祭葬如製，諡文莊。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he died; the emperor mourned and regretted, granted sacrificial burial according to regulations, and gave the posthumous name Wenzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: In 1884 he died; the emperor mourned him, granted sacrificial burial according to regulations, and gave the posthumous name Wenzhuang.

sentences.zh: 張英麟，字振卿，山東歷城人。

translations.literal: Zhang Yinglin, courtesy name Zhenqing, was a native of Licheng in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yinglin, styled Zhenqing, came from Licheng in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 同治四年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tongzhi he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and was appointed Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In 1865 he passed the palace examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and was appointed a compiler in the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 十三年，命偕檢討王慶祺在弘德殿行走。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was ordered, together with Reviser Wang Qingqi, to attend in the Hall of Illustrious Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: In 1874 he was ordered, together with Reviser Wang Qingqi, to serve in the Hall of Illustrious Virtue.

sentences.zh: 英麟甫入直，即乞假歸省。

translations.literal: Yinglin had only just entered regular service when he requested leave to return home to visit his parents.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglin had only just entered regular service when he requested leave to return home to visit his parents.

sentences.zh: 未幾，穆宗崩，慶祺以有罪褫職。

translations.literal: Before long Emperor Muzong died; Qingqi was stripped of office for guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Emperor Muzong died; Qingqi was stripped of office for misconduct.

sentences.zh: 眾皆稱其志節。

translations.literal: All praised his moral resolve.
translations.idiomatic: All praised his moral resolve.

sentences.zh: 歷典福建、雲南鄉試，累遷祭酒，充經筵講官。

translations.literal: He presided over the Fujian and Yunnan provincial examinations in succession, was repeatedly promoted to Libationer, and served as lecturer at the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: He presided over the Fujian and Yunnan provincial examinations in succession, rose to Libationer, and served as lecturer at the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 光緒十七年，以詹事授奉天府丞，兼學政。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Guangxu, as Junior Mentor he was appointed Vice Magistrate of Shuntian Prefecture and concurrently educational commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 1891, as Junior Mentor, he was appointed Vice Magistrate of Shuntian Prefecture and concurrently educational commissioner.

sentences.zh: 奉省士民樸素，隨軺所至，力加獎勸，學風興起。

translations.literal: The gentry and people of Fengtian province were plain and simple; wherever his inspection carriage went, he vigorously encouraged them, and scholarly custom flourished.
translations.idiomatic: The gentry and people of Fengtian were plain and simple; wherever his inspection carriage went, he vigorously encouraged them, and scholarly culture flourished.

sentences.zh: 晉內閣學士，簡順天學政，擢吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was advanced to Grand Secretariat Academician, selected as Shuntian educational commissioner, and promoted to Vice Minister of the Board of Civil Office.
translations.idiomatic: He was advanced to Grand Secretariat Academician, appointed Shuntian educational commissioner, and promoted to Vice Minister of the Board of Civil Office.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，通州試竣回京，兩宮西狩，官吏遷避，英麟獨守學政關防待交替。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, when the Tongzhou examination ended and he returned to the capital, the two palaces went west on tour; officials fled and avoided [duty], but Yinglin alone guarded the educational commissioner's seal awaiting transfer of office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1900, when the Tongzhou examination ended and he returned to the capital, the two palaces fled west; officials fled their posts, but Yinglin alone guarded the educational commissioner's seal awaiting his successor.

sentences.zh: 明年，召赴行在，應詔上疏，請力崇節儉。

translations.literal: The next year he was summoned to the traveling court, responded to the edict with a memorial, and requested vigorous promotion of thrift.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was summoned to the traveling court, responded to the edict with a memorial, and urged vigorous promotion of thrift.

sentences.zh: 乘輿回鑾，議變法，英麟言祖宗法制，可整飭不可遽更張。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage returned, reform was discussed; Yinglin said that the ancestral institutions could be rectified but could not be rashly overturned.
translations.idiomatic: When the court returned to the capital, reform was discussed; Yinglin argued that ancestral institutions could be rectified but must not be rashly overturned.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，充會試副總裁，借闈河南，改試策論、經義。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he served as Associate Metropolitan Examination Director, borrowed the Henan examination compound, and changed the examination to policy essays and classical exposition.
translations.idiomatic: In 1903 he served as Associate Metropolitan Examination Director, used the Henan examination compound, and changed the examination format to policy essays and classical exposition.

sentences.zh: 英麟嚴衡校，多取績學。

translations.literal: Yinglin was strict in examination and grading, and mostly selected solid scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglin graded strictly and mostly selected solid scholars.

sentences.zh: 會改官制，英麟以侍郎遷副都統，漢員授旗官自此始。

translations.literal: When the official system was reformed, Yinglin moved from vice minister to vice commandant; from this time Han officials began receiving banner appointments.
translations.idiomatic: When the official system was reformed, Yinglin moved from vice minister to vice commandant — the first time a Han official received a banner appointment.

sentences.zh: 旋晉都統。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was advanced to commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he was advanced to commandant.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，授都御史。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year he was appointed Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In 1908 he was appointed Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 時議行憲政，許士民上書，英麟必詳審為代達。

translations.literal: At the time constitutional government was discussed and gentry and commoners were permitted to submit memorials; Yinglin always examined them in detail and conveyed them on their behalf.
translations.idiomatic: When constitutional government was discussed and commoners were permitted to submit memorials, Yinglin always examined them carefully and conveyed them to the throne.

sentences.zh: 御史江春霖直劾親貴，斥回原衙門，英麟率全台合疏留之。

translations.literal: The censor Jiang Chunlin directly impeached imperial relatives and was dismissed back to his original post; Yinglin led the entire censorate in a joint memorial to retain him.
translations.idiomatic: When Censor Jiang Chunlin directly impeached imperial relatives and was dismissed to his original post, Yinglin led the entire censorate in a joint memorial to retain him.

sentences.zh: 宣統改元，攝政監國，复舉輪講之典。

translations.literal: At the change of reign to Xuantong, the regent supervised the state, and the rotating lecture ceremony was again instituted.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Xuantong reign, with the regent supervising the state, the rotating lecture ceremony was revived.

sentences.zh: 英麟撰資治通鑑講章以進，皆發明精義，比附近情，冀以誠意相感動，章上，但循故事留覽而已。

translations.literal: Yinglin composed lecture chapters on the Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government and submitted them; all elucidated refined meaning and drew parallels close to human feeling, hoping to move [the regent] through sincerity — when the chapters were submitted, they were only kept for review according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglin composed lecture chapters on the Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government and submitted them; all elucidated refined meaning and drew parallels close to human affairs, hoping to move the regent through sincerity — when submitted, they were only kept for review according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 三年，武昌變起，內閣改制，飭都察院及凡有言責者皆停奏事，英麟嘆息以為奇變。

translations.literal: In the third year the Wuchang uprising arose; the Grand Secretariat was reorganized, and the Censorate and all who bore the duty of speech were ordered to cease submitting memorials; Yinglin sighed, taking it as an extraordinary change.
translations.idiomatic: In 1911 the Wuchang uprising erupted; the Grand Secretariat was reorganized, and the Censorate and all remonstrating officials were ordered to cease submitting memorials; Yinglin sighed, taking it as an extraordinary change.

sentences.zh: 遜位詔下，遂乞罷歸。

translations.literal: When the abdication edict was issued, he then requested dismissal and return home.
translations.idiomatic: When the abdication edict was issued, he requested dismissal and return home.

sentences.zh: 德宗永遠奉安，猶奔赴崇陵謁送。

translations.literal: When Emperor Dezong was permanently laid to rest, he still rushed to Chongling to pay respects at the farewell.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Guangxu was permanently laid to rest, he still rushed to Chongling to pay his respects at the farewell.

sentences.zh: 重宴瓊林，加太子太保。

translations.literal: At the repeat Banquet of the Forest of Brilliants he was given the additional title Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: At the repeat Banquet of the Forest of Brilliants he was given the additional title Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 乙丑冬，卒，年八十有八。

translations.literal: In the winter of the yichou year he died, aged eighty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of 1925 he died, aged eighty-eight.

sentences.zh: 張仁黼，字劭予，河南固始人。

translations.literal: Zhang Renfu, courtesy name Shaoyu, was a native of Gushi in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Renfu, styled Shaoyu, came from Gushi in Henan.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年進士，選庶吉士，授編修，入直上書房。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, appointed Compiler, and entered regular service in the Upper Study.
translations.idiomatic: In 1876 he passed the palace examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, appointed a compiler, and joined the Upper Study staff.

sentences.zh: 出督湖北學政，以硃子小學、近思錄訓士。

translations.literal: He went out to supervise education in Hubei, instructing scholars with Zhu Xi's Elementary Learning and Reflections on Things at Hand.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as educational commissioner of Hubei, instructing scholars with Zhu Xi's Elementary Learning and Reflections on Things at Hand.

sentences.zh: 累遷洗馬，充日講起居注官，補侍講。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Groom, served as Daily Lecturer and Recorder of the Emperor's Movements, and was made up as Lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Groom, served as Daily Lecturer and Recorder of the Emperor's Activities, and was appointed Lecturer.

sentences.zh: 二十年，日本釁起，樞臣被劾。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year the Japanese quarrel arose and Grand Councilors were impeached.
translations.idiomatic: In 1894 the war with Japan erupted and Grand Councilors were impeached.

sentences.zh: 乃與李文田等請起用恭親王奕訢，稱旨。

translations.literal: He then joined Li Wentian and others in requesting the restoration of Prince Gong Yixin — this pleased the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined Li Wentian and others in requesting the restoration of Prince Gong Yixin — this pleased the emperor.

sentences.zh: 遷鴻臚寺卿，典試四川。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Minister of the Court of State Ceremonial and presided over the Sichuan examination.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Minister of the Court of State Ceremonial and presided over the Sichuan examination.

sentences.zh: 除奉天府府丞，父憂，未之官。

translations.literal: He was appointed Vice Magistrate of Shuntian Prefecture, but on his father's mourning he did not take up the post.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Vice Magistrate of Shuntian Prefecture, but entered mourning for his father before taking up the post.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，拳亂作，奉命在籍治團練。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the Boxer uprising arose; he was ordered to organize militia in his native place.
translations.idiomatic: In 1900 the Boxer uprising erupted; he was ordered to organize militia in his native place.

sentences.zh: 服闋，赴行在。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he went to the traveling court.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he went to the traveling court.

sentences.zh: 時財匱，議加丁口稅。

translations.literal: At the time finances were depleted, and there was discussion of increasing the poll tax.
translations.idiomatic: At the time finances were depleted, and there was discussion of increasing the poll tax.

sentences.zh: 仁黼謂：「今日國勢極危，而人心未去者，良由世祖除明季三餉；

translations.literal: Renfu said: "Today the national situation is extremely perilous, yet the people's hearts have not departed — this is truly because the Shizu Emperor abolished the three levies of the late Ming;
translations.idiomatic: Renfu said, "Today the national situation is extremely perilous, yet the people's hearts have not departed — this is truly because the Shunzhi Emperor abolished the three levies of the late Ming;

sentences.zh: 聖祖詔丁口以五十年為率，嗣後滋生永不加賦：深仁厚澤，民不能忘。

translations.literal: the Sacred Ancestor decreed that poll registers take fifty years as the standard, and that thereafter new growth would never be added to the levy — profound benevolence and thick grace, which the people cannot forget.
translations.idiomatic: the Kangxi Emperor decreed that poll registers take fifty years as the standard, and that thereafter new growth would never be added to the levy — profound benevolence that the people cannot forget.

sentences.zh: 今議加丁稅，違祖制，拂民情，必不可。

translations.literal: Now to discuss increasing the poll tax violates the ancestral system, goes against the people's feelings, and absolutely cannot be done.
translations.idiomatic: To increase the poll tax now would violate ancestral institutions, go against the people's feelings, and absolutely cannot be done.

sentences.zh: 」事遂寢。

translations.literal: The matter was ultimately shelved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was shelved.

sentences.zh: 還京，擢順天府府尹。

translations.literal: Returning to the capital, he was promoted to Metropolitan Magistrate of Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to the capital, he was promoted to Metropolitan Magistrate of Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 再遷兵部侍郎，典試江西，歷學部、法部。

translations.literal: He was again promoted to Vice Minister of War, presided over the Jiangxi examination, and served in the Boards of Education and Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was again promoted to Vice Minister of War, presided over the Jiangxi examination, and served in the Boards of Education and Justice.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，補大理院正卿，奏請敕部院大臣會訂法律，略言：「法律主要在乎組織立法機關，而所以成之者有三，曰：定法律宗旨，辨法律性質，編法律成典。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year he was appointed Chief Justice of the Court of Revision and memorialized requesting that ministers of the boards and courts be ordered to meet and revise the laws, stating in brief: "Law chiefly lies in organizing legislative bodies, and what completes them has three parts: defining the purpose of law, distinguishing the nature of law, and compiling law into a code.
translations.idiomatic: In 1907 he was appointed Chief Justice of the Court of Revision and memorialized requesting that ministers of the boards and courts meet to revise the laws, stating in brief: "Law chiefly lies in organizing legislative bodies, and completing it requires three steps: defining the purpose of law, distinguishing the nature of law, and compiling law into a code.

sentences.zh: 中國數千年來，禮陶樂淑，人人皆知尊君親上。

translations.literal: For several thousand years in China, ritual has molded and music has refined; everyone knows to honor the ruler and cherish superiors.
translations.idiomatic: For several thousand years in China, ritual has molded and music has refined the people; everyone knows to honor the ruler and cherish superiors.

sentences.zh: 此乃國粹所在，必宜保存，用各國之法以補其不足。

translations.literal: This is where the national essence lies and must be preserved, using the laws of various countries to supplement what is lacking.
translations.idiomatic: This is the national essence and must be preserved, using foreign laws to supplement what is lacking.

sentences.zh: 尤須造就法律人才，治法治人，相因為用，然後可收實效。

translations.literal: Especially one must train legal talent — governing law and governing people mutually reinforcing in use — only then can real results be obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Especially one must train legal talent — governing law and governing people reinforcing each other — only then can real results be obtained.

sentences.zh: 」又言：「立法之要，規模不可不閎，推行必宜有漸。

translations.literal: He also said: "The essentials of legislation — the scope cannot but be broad, yet implementation must proceed gradually.
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "The essentials of legislation — the scope must be broad, yet implementation must proceed gradually.

sentences.zh: 否則未當於人心而貿然以試，誠恐外國屬人主義勢力日益擴張，而吾國屬地主義處理愈形棼糾。

translations.literal: Otherwise, if it does not accord with people's hearts yet is rashly tried, I truly fear that foreign personalist jurisdiction will daily expand its power, while our territorial jurisdiction will grow ever more tangled in handling.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise, if it does not accord with popular sentiment yet is rashly tried, I truly fear that foreign personal jurisdiction will daily expand, while our territorial jurisdiction will grow ever more tangled.

sentences.zh: 有司奉行不善，反使外人得以藉口，為患甚大。

translations.literal: If officials carry it out poorly, foreigners will instead gain a pretext — the harm would be very great.
translations.idiomatic: If officials carry it out poorly, foreigners will gain a pretext — the harm would be very great.

sentences.zh: 」疏入，多議行。

translations.literal: When the memorial entered, most of it was deliberated and carried out.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was received, most of its proposals were approved.

sentences.zh: 俄授吏部侍郎，充經筵講官。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he was appointed Vice Minister of the Board of Civil Office and served as lecturer at the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he was appointed Vice Minister of the Board of Civil Office and served as lecturer at the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，丁母憂。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year he entered mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: In 1908 he entered mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 未幾，卒。

translations.literal: Before long he died.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died.

sentences.zh: 仁黼內行修，不自標異。

translations.literal: Renfu's inner conduct was cultivated, and he did not set himself apart.
translations.idiomatic: Renfu's private conduct was cultivated, and he did not set himself apart.

sentences.zh: 嘗被命治河，卻例饋節省金，同官懼，謂將興大獄。

translations.literal: He was once ordered to manage river works and declined the customary gifts of saved funds; his colleagues were afraid, saying a major case would be raised.
translations.idiomatic: He was once ordered to manage river works and declined the customary gifts of saved funds; his colleagues were afraid, saying a major investigation would be launched.

sentences.zh: 仁黼忽索取金，眾始安，然頗怪其失操。

translations.literal: Renfu suddenly demanded the gold; the crowd was then reassured, yet many wondered at his lapse in integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Renfu suddenly demanded the gold; his colleagues were reassured, yet many wondered at his lapse in integrity.

sentences.zh: 已而河南巡撫上言紳士助學校金，不受獎敘，數與之同。

translations.literal: Before long the Henan governor memorialized that gentry and scholars had contributed funds to schools, which he did not accept for reward or citation — the amount was the same.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Henan governor memorialized that gentry and scholars had contributed school funds, which Renfu did not accept for reward or citation — the amount was the same.

sentences.zh: 朝士益服其清不絕物雲。

translations.literal: Court scholars increasingly admired his purity without rejecting worldly affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Court scholars increasingly admired his integrity without rejecting worldly affairs.

sentences.zh: 張亨嘉，字燮鈞，福建侯官人。

translations.literal: Zhang Hengjia, courtesy name Xiejun, was a native of Houguan in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hengjia, styled Xiejun, came from Houguan in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 光緒九年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Guangxu he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and was appointed Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: In 1883 he passed the palace examination, was selected as a Hanlin bachelor, and was appointed a compiler in the Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 十四年，視學湖南，念儒官為士模範，不激濁揚清，曷以勵風教？

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he inspected education in Hunan, reflecting that Confucian officials are models for scholars — if one does not stir the muddy and elevate the clear, how can one encourage custom and teaching?
translations.idiomatic: In 1888 he inspected education in Hunan, reflecting that Confucian officials are models for scholars — if one does not stir the muddy and elevate the clear, how can one encourage custom and teaching?

sentences.zh: 疏薦文行交修者數人，士習為一變。

translations.literal: He memorialized recommending several men of cultivated literary conduct, and scholarly custom was transformed.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized recommending several men of cultivated literary conduct, and scholarly custom was transformed.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，入直南書房。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he entered regular service in the Southern Studio.
translations.idiomatic: In 1897 he joined the Southern Studio staff.

sentences.zh: 越二年，除司業，頻轉太常寺少卿。

translations.literal: After two years he was appointed Vice Director of Studies and was frequently transferred to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later he was appointed Vice Director of Studies and was quickly transferred to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 一歲五遷，殊數也。

translations.literal: Five promotions in one year — an extraordinary number.
translations.idiomatic: Five promotions in one year — an extraordinary number.

sentences.zh: 二十六年夏，親貴大臣信拳民有神術能攘外，飾詞入告，上疑之，命亨嘉察視。

translations.literal: In the summer of the twenty-sixth year, imperial relatives and great ministers believed the Boxers had divine arts that could repel foreigners; they embellished their words in reporting to the throne; the emperor was doubtful and ordered Hengjia to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of 1900, imperial relatives and great ministers believed the Boxers had divine arts that could repel foreigners; they embellished their reports to the throne; the emperor was doubtful and ordered Hengjia to investigate.

sentences.zh: 亨嘉知其不可恃，條上弭釁機宜甚悉，疏甫入而亂作。

translations.literal: Hengjia knew they could not be relied upon and submitted a detailed list of measures to quell the quarrel; the memorial had only just entered when disorder broke out.
translations.idiomatic: Hengjia knew they could not be relied upon and submitted a detailed list of measures to quell the crisis; his memorial had only just arrived when disorder broke out.

sentences.zh: 西狩還，獨先賜用，徙大理寺卿。

translations.literal: After the western tour and return, he alone was first granted employment and was transferred to Minister of the Court of Revision.
