translations.idiomatic: After the court returned from its flight west, he alone was first restored to office and transferred to Minister of the Court of Revision.

sentences.zh: 明年，出督浙江學政，頗採西國政教命題試士，多得通材。

translations.literal: The next year he went out to supervise education in Zhejiang, largely drawing on Western politics and education for examination topics, and obtained many broadly capable men.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he went out as educational commissioner of Zhejiang, largely drawing on Western politics and education for examination topics, and selected many broadly capable men.

sentences.zh: 尚書張百熙、榮慶既為學務大臣，別置大學總監督，亨嘉遂被命任校事，仍不離內廷職。

translations.literal: After Ministers Zhang Baixi and Rong Qing became educational affairs ministers, a separate post of university superintendent was established; Hengjia was then ordered to manage school affairs while still not leaving his inner-court duties.
translations.idiomatic: After Ministers Zhang Baixi and Rong Qing became educational affairs ministers, a separate post of university superintendent was established; Hengjia was ordered to manage the university while retaining his inner-court duties.

sentences.zh: 大學中更寇亂，肄業生不盈百，乃闢學舍，廣集高材生。

translations.literal: The university had again suffered from bandit turmoil; enrolled students did not reach a hundred — he then opened school buildings and broadly gathered talented students.
translations.idiomatic: The university had again suffered from turmoil; enrolled students numbered fewer than a hundred — he opened new school buildings and broadly gathered talented students.

sentences.zh: 類別學科，禮聘儒宿及東西邦學人專門教授。

translations.literal: He classified subjects by discipline and ceremonially invited veteran Confucians and scholars of East and West for specialized instruction.
translations.idiomatic: He classified subjects by discipline and ceremonially invited veteran Confucians and scholars from East and West for specialized instruction.

sentences.zh: 書籍儀器，粲然具備。

translations.literal: Books and instruments were brilliantly complete.
translations.idiomatic: Books and instruments were abundantly provided.

sentences.zh: 兼攝進士館監督，進士習法政自此始。

translations.literal: He concurrently served as superintendent of the Advanced Scholar Hall; advanced scholars studying law and administration began from this time.
translations.idiomatic: He concurrently served as superintendent of the Advanced Scholar Hall; training advanced scholars in law and administration began from this time.

sentences.zh: 歷光祿寺卿、左副都御史、兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: He served as Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief, and Vice Minister of War in succession.
translations.idiomatic: He served in succession as Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief, and Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 逾歲，疏辭校職，轉禮部侍郎，充經筵講官。

translations.literal: After more than a year he memorialized to resign his school post, was transferred to Vice Minister of Rites, and served as lecturer at the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year he memorialized to resign his university post, was transferred to Vice Minister of Rites, and served as lecturer at the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 亨嘉為人敦實，嗜古精鑑賞。

translations.literal: Hengjia as a man was solid and sincere, fond of antiquities and skilled in connoisseurship.
translations.idiomatic: Hengjia was solid and sincere, fond of antiquities and skilled in connoisseurship.

sentences.zh: 事母孝，母黃氏，壽百歲，同列奏庥瑞。

translations.literal: He was filial toward his mother; his mother, née Huang, lived to a hundred years; his colleagues memorialized this as a blessing and auspicious sign.
translations.idiomatic: He was filial toward his mother; his mother, née Huang, lived to a hundred years; his colleagues memorialized this as a blessing and auspicious sign.

sentences.zh: 中興後命婦享高耄者，與詹事袁葆恆祖母郭氏二人而已。

translations.literal: After the restoration, among titled ladies who enjoyed great old age, only he and Junior Mentor Yuan Baoheng's grandmother, née Guo, were the two.
translations.idiomatic: After the restoration, among titled ladies who enjoyed great old age, only his mother and Junior Mentor Yuan Baoheng's grandmother, née Guo, were the two.

sentences.zh: 上聞之嘆異，加恩賜予。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard of it he sighed in wonder and granted additional favor and gifts.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard of it he sighed in wonder and granted additional favors and gifts.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，遭喪去，終服，仍入直。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year he left on mourning; when mourning ended he again entered regular service.
translations.idiomatic: In 1908 he left on mourning; when mourning ended he again entered regular palace service.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，卒，賜祭葬，諡文厚。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuantong he died; sacrificial burial was granted, and he was given the posthumous name Wenhou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1910 he died; sacrificial burial was granted, and he was given the posthumous name Wenhou.

sentences.zh: 論曰：同、光典學內直諸臣，每兼授讀，體制較隆；

translations.literal: The commentary says: During the Tongzhi and Guangxu reigns, the ministers who presided over learning in inner regular service each also held tutoring posts — the institution was comparatively elevated;
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: During the Tongzhi and Guangxu reigns, the ministers who presided over learning in inner regular service each also held tutoring posts — the institution was comparatively elevated;

sentences.zh: 而文學侍從，亦多選績學，時備顧問，稱榮幸焉。

translations.literal: and among the literary attendants, many solid scholars were also selected, at times serving as advisers — all called it an honor.
translations.idiomatic: and among the literary attendants, many solid scholars were also selected to serve as advisers at court — all called it an honor.

sentences.zh: 祖廕好賢勤事，文田學識淹雅，同以通博稱。

translations.literal: Zuyin loved worthies and was diligent in affairs; Wentian's learning was broad and elegant — both were famed for comprehensive erudition.
translations.idiomatic: Zuyin loved worthies and was diligent in affairs; Wentian's learning was broad and elegant — both were famed for comprehensive erudition.

sentences.zh: 詒經重實學，同善崇聖德，家驤盡心誨納，英麟早勵風節，並無愧師儒。

translations.literal: Yijing valued practical learning; Tongshan revered sagely virtue; Jiaxiang devoted his heart to instruction and remonstrance; Yinglin early cultivated moral resolve — all were without shame as teacher-scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Yijing valued practical learning; Tongshan revered sagely virtue; Jiaxiang devoted himself to instruction and remonstrance; Yinglin early cultivated moral resolve — all were worthy teacher-scholars.

sentences.zh: 仁黼、亨嘉尤惓惓於明法修學，後先相望，其風采皆隱然可見焉。

translations.literal: Renfu and Hengjia were especially earnest in clarifying law and cultivating learning; one after another they succeeded each other, and their bearing can all be dimly seen.
translations.idiomatic: Renfu and Hengjia were especially earnest in clarifying law and cultivating learning; succeeding one another in time, their bearing can still be dimly discerned.
